subtitle: Lesson 22 · Dashboards & Reporting

code:
MTTD = Detection Timestamp  −  Attack Start Timestamp
MTTR = Resolution Timestamp −  Detection Timestamp

MTTD measures AWARENESS.  MTTR measures ACTION.
caption: A SOC can be excellent at one and still weak at the other — they measure different things.

code:
1:15 PM  Attacker's first malicious login (found in log review)
2:47 PM  SIEM rule fires  ->  MTTD = 92 minutes
2:55 PM  Escalated to Tier 2
3:40 PM  Account disabled, host isolated  ->  MTTR = 53 minutes
caption: MTTD runs from attack start to detection; MTTR runs from detection to actual containment.
